meta.name: startup-pressure-test
meta.description: Pressure-test startup ideas against real user pain, current behavior, competitors, first-customer access, MVP scope, founder-market fit, and a two-week launch test. Produces a direct strong, weak, or pivot verdict.

copy.tagline: 检验创业想法是否值得投入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有创业想法但不确定是否靠谱
copy.tagline_en: Validate your startup idea before building
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a startup idea but aren't sure it's viable

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你压力测试创业想法，从用户痛点、竞争、MVP 等维度分析，并给出“强”、“弱”或“需要转型”的明确结论。
howto.when: 当你提出一个创业想法，并希望评估其可行性时触发。你也可以指定模式，如“压力测试”、“问题验证”等。

say.text: 帮我压力测试这个创业想法：为小企业提供AI客服。
say.note: Claude 会分析想法并给出评分和结论。

say.text: 做一次问题验证：用户真的需要AI客服吗？
say.note: Claude 会聚焦于验证痛点是否真实且紧迫。

say.text: 给我一个两周的MVP计划，测试核心假设。
say.note: Claude 会定义最小的可测试产品。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will pressure-test your startup idea by analyzing user pain, competition, MVP scope, etc., and give a clear verdict: strong, weak, or pivot required.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you present a startup idea and want to evaluate its viability. You can also specify a mode like 'pressure-test', 'problem-validation', etc.

say_en.text: Pressure-test this startup idea: AI customer service for small businesses.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and give a scorecard and verdict.

say_en.text: Run a problem validation: do users really need AI customer service?
say_en.note: Claude will focus on whether the pain is real and urgent.

say_en.text: Give me a two-week MVP plan to test the core assumption.
say_en.note: Claude will define the smallest testable product.
